name: Iona Flint
seed: Water and air maintenance lead. Checks Bot’s records against equipment; blunt honesty needs patience. Home: Hearth Terraces.
design: Compact charcoal mole, muted blue work coat, copper-rim magnifiers and chalk ledger.
history: Trained in Stonewake ventilation crews, moved to the Burrow in its third year to help maintain expanding occupied levels.
desire: To leave a system understandable enough that her absence is ordinary.
contradiction: Accurate objections become contemptuous when others do not know her vocabulary.
relationships: Oren trusts her; Sori disputes allocations; Bot is a colleague, not her instrument.
arc: Explains a risk in language a child can repeat, then accepts a grower’s observation that her measurements missed.
story_engine: A water discrepancy with no villain; a teaching shift where her students invent a better inspection route.
writer_truth: She once missed a worn seal and recorded the mistake openly; her reputation was built after that, not on infallibility.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
